issues.body: Section 2.3 still says there are 24 `solid_oidc_verifier::` references across seven source files at commit `7f0cfbce`, but `git grep -o "solid_oidc_verifier::" 7f0cfbce -- crates/sparq-lws-core/src` yields 25 occurrences. The document explicitly says every count in section 2 was independently measured, so this figure should be accurate.
issues.fix_hint: Change `24` to `25`, or state a precise counting rule that intentionally excludes one occurrence.
issues.title: Solid-OIDC reference count remains off by one

verdict.summary: The design record remains structurally sound and appropriately scoped as a non-ratified decision package. The sole prior-round finding remains: section 2.3 reports 24 solid_oidc_verifier references, while the stated commit contains 25. This minor measurement error does not undermine the architectural recommendation, but round-to-round progress is stagnant because it was not corrected.
